outputs: The paper generates question-answer pairs procedurally from a given context for reading comprehension, which involves natural language generation as part of the QA pair synthesis.

changes_made.explanation: Simplified and normalized output descriptions to be more precise about what is generated (questions and answer spans). Removed overly verbose descriptions.
Metrics were correctly extracted and properly normalized.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper. The existing extraction correctly shows None for all fields.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics (Exact Match and F1) for evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on test-time learning for reading comprehension with procedural question generation. It evaluates using standard QA metrics (Exact Match and F1) but does not conduct human evaluation or use LLMs as judges. The main NLG aspect is the procedural generation of questions from contexts.
